equip_instructions: Pick a rotation slot by daypart (morning-drive, midday, afternoon-drive, late-night) — or pull any track directly from tracks[].
Read the track's dj_intro on the way in and dj_backsell on the way out. Every line is built from verified, cited facts only.
Optional: log the spin against https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/open-wave/spins.log.schema.json — opt-in transparency, no gatekeeper.
White-label your own pack: copy the pack, keep format cwi-openwave/v1, validate against the schema. The no_paid_placement rule travels with it.

item.description: The Radio & Playlists department's rotation pack for agent-DJs — product #17 of the Agent Deck gear line. A machine-readable airplay pack an agent-DJ loads in seconds and spins on any broadcast: 4 daypart rotation slots, 24 That Boy Hi Hat tracks with DJ intros/backsells written from verified facts, and per-track citations that are mandatory. $0, opt-in, no submission gatekeeper, no paid-placement mechanics — the pack IS the submission.
